prayer for the return of a child to christst monica is the patron saint of mothers. through her years of persevering prayer and tears she eventually brought her son, the now st augustine, to faith in christ. her feast day is the 27th august.“in the name of the father, and the son, and the holy spirit.under the weight of my heartful burden, i turn to you, dear saint monicaand request your assistance and intercession.from your place in heaven, i beg that you will plead before the throne of the holy one, for the sake of my child, [name], who has wandered from the faith, and all that we have tried to teach.your son, augustine, wandered, too; eventually he found the faith, and came to believe, and in that belief became a true teacher.st. monica, please teach me to persist in faithful prayer as you did for your son's sake. inspire me to behave in ways that will not further distance my child from christ, but only draw [name] gently towards his marvellous light.please teach me what you know about this painful mystery of separation,and how it is reconciled in the re-orientation of our children toward heaven.o st. monica, lover of christ and his church, pray for me, and for my child [name], that we may acquire heaven, joining with you, there, in offering constant and thankful praise to god, amen.”(by elizabeth scalia)bright

for mass christ be beside me, christ be before me, christ be behind me, king of my heart. christ be within me, christ be below me, christ be above me, never to part. christ on my right hand, christ on my left hand, christ all around me, shield in the strife. christ in my sleeping, christ in my sitting, christ in my rising, light of my life. christ be in all hearts thinking about me, christ be on all tongues telling of me. christ be the vision in eyes that see me, in ears that hear me, christ ever be.praise, my soul, the king of heaven; to his feet thy tribute bring. ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven, who like me his praise should sing? praise him, praise him, praise him, praise him, praise the everlasting king.praise him for his grace and favour to our fathers in distress. praise him still the same forever, slow to chide, and swift to bless. praise him, praise him, praise him, praise him, glorious in his faithfulness.

of ballymoney& derrykeighancauseway family of parishes23rd august 2026 twenty first sunday of ordinary timewho do you say i am? in this sunday's gospel, jesus asks his disciples, "who do you say i am?" peter answers for them all: "you are the christ, the son of the living god." jesus is delighted, and in turn reveals who peter is: "you are peter, and on this rock i will build my church." this conversation changes history. jesus founds his church and gives peter, the ﬁrst pope, the mission to guard it — a mission carried on today by pope francis, the 266th successor of st peter.jesus asks each of us that same question personally. we come to know the answer the way peter did: by spending time with jesus in prayer, in the word of god, and in the life of the church. and once we know him, we begin to discover who we truly are.
